in_hebrew.name: לינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word 'linah' which means 'lily' or 'palm tree'. The name Lynne may have been derived from the Old English word 'linan' which means 'to mix' or 'to weave', as the lily and the palm tree are often associated with the intertwining of life and death.

in_greek.name: Λύννη
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'lynnē' which means 'maiden' or 'young girl'. The name Lynne may have been adopted from the Greek name 'Lynnē' due to its similarity in sound and meaning to the English name.

in_latin.name: Lynna
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'lynx' which means 'lynx' or 'lioness'. The name Lynne may have been derived from the Latin name 'Lynna' due to the similarity in sound and meaning, as the lynx is a symbol of strength and agility in the Christian tradition.
